# Requirement Traceability Protocol

## Purpose
Track requirements through the entire development lifecycle:
Requirement → Plan Task → Code File → Test Case → Review Verdict.

## Trace ID Format
`REQ-{feature}-{NNN}` (e.g., REQ-payment-001)

Assigned by:
- bk-bootstrap: during BRD requirement extraction (primary source)
- bk-plan: if requirements created during planning (with REQ- prefix)

## Trace Chain

| Stage | File | REQ Reference |
|-------|------|---------------|
| Requirements | bk/dev/{feature}/srs-*.md | Defines REQ-{feature}-NNN |
| Plan | bk/dev/{feature}/sub-task-*.md | YAML `traces: [REQ-xxx]` |
| Code | Source files | Comment `// REQ-{feature}-NNN` near implementation |
| Tests | Test files | Test name or comment references REQ ID |
| Review | Review report | Coverage check against REQ list |

## Traceability Matrix
Path: `bk/dev/{feature}/traceability-matrix.md`
Generated by bk-project-manager during finalize phase.

Format:
| REQ ID | Description | Plan Task | Code Files | Tests | Review | Status |
|--------|------------|-----------|------------|-------|--------|--------|
| REQ-payment-001 | QR scan | sub-task-01 | PaymentVM.swift | testQRScan | Approved | ✅ Covered |
| REQ-payment-002 | History | — | — | — | — | ❌ Not implemented |

Coverage = covered / total × 100%

## Integration Points
- **bk-bootstrap**: Assign REQ IDs when extracting requirements
- **bk-plan**: Reference REQ IDs in sub-task YAML `traces:` field
- **bk-code**: Dev agents include REQ IDs in code comments
- **bk-project-manager**: Generate traceability-matrix.md during finalize
- **traceability-check.cjs**: Warn if coverage < 80% before commit

## Constraints
- REQ IDs are immutable once assigned
- All plan sub-tasks SHOULD reference at least 1 REQ ID
- Traceability is recommended for Standard/Complex tiers, optional for Trivial
